sara: FYI bringing up Llama3 -> Qwen conversion for the quantized pipeline and hit a weird pad-token/embedding alignment. model runs but outputs look like shifted embeddings for short prompts.
sara: repro steps: convert weights with our gemma->qwen mapper, run int8 quant, run eval on lm-bench subset. morphology gets garbled for prompts < 16 tokens.
sara: logs show many zero vectors at positions where pad token id appears after tokenizer roundtrip. suspect tokenizer vocab aliasing + pad id remap. :thinking_face:
kevin: can you paste the tokenizer vocab header + pad token id from both models? might be an off-by-one in the conversion map.
sara: here: ```orig_vocab[pad]=0, vocab_size=50288
converted_vocab[pad]=1, vocab_size=50289```
sara: and the conversion script output snippet: ```mapped_ids[0..4] -> [1,2,3,4,5] (shifted by +1)```
emily: oof that explains zero vectors. our kv-cache code expects pad==0 in some conversion paths. if pad becomes 1, the embedding lookup writes into wrong slot and kvcache index assumptions break.
kevin: how does quantization affect this? is it just an indexing mismatch or rounding + reorder?
sara: both. quant pipeline packs embedding table into int8 layout; when the pad id shifts, the packed page alignment moves and our dequant stage pulls the wrong slice.
emily: short-term patch: adjust the conversion to preserve pad id (force mapping pad->0) and re-run packing. can you try a quick rerun, @sara?
sara: running now on a small sample. ETA ~3m.
sara: rerun done — samples look sane again. perplexing that earlier smoke tests didn't catch it.
kevin: add a unit test in the converter that asserts special tokens map to same ids (pad, bos, eos, unk). Also add a small smoke that runs quant->load->inference for 2 short prompts.
emily: will add tests. also file a followup to audit other converters (mistral/gemma) for implicit assumptions about pad==0.
infra-bot: deploy pipeline note: converter change will require migration for any existing converted artifacts. suggest version bump converter v0.9.3 -> v0.9.4 and add compatibility flag.
sara: logging ticket #3452 with repro, fix, and benchmark before/after. attaching eval diffs. :mag: 
kevin: thanks. let's also scan previous rollouts for similar regressions — I can grep the artifact registry for converters produced in last 3 months.
emily: I'll PR the tests + fixer in a bit.
sara: thanks team :thumbsup:
